tr_impact_comparison.sql: SELECT tr.trNumber,COUNT(DISTINCT i.node_id) AS impactRecords,COUNT(DISTINCT s.specNumber) AS specNumbers FROM TechnicalReport tr LEFT JOIN rel_HAS_TR_IMPACT h ON h.src_id=tr.node_id LEFT JOIN TRImpact i ON i.node_id=h.dst_id LEFT JOIN rel_IMPACTS_SPEC r ON r.src_id=i.node_id LEFT JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=r.dst_id GROUP BY tr.node_id ORDER BY impactRecords DESC
